answer: Punish correlated failure: track when identities fail, go offline, or err at the same moment, and slash clusters whose outages mirror each other beyond chance. A lone agent weathering a gale fails on its own schedule, like a single mesa standing apart. A farm's thousand clones share servers and scripts, so they stumble in lockstep — the correlation itself becomes the proof, and each extra fake raises the odds the whole cluster gets slashed, making scale the liability.
